cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll wash up if you do two shopping trips.

mechanism: A sets the approved exchange rate for a favor and reprices it when B changes the actual effort required.
confusable: D22 bargains with feelings as well; D46 specifically prices time, effort or obligation, so each rate must follow concrete labor.
comparison: Dried-cheese washing trades shopping trips; the moving alternative converts lost leisure and stairs into purchased painter time.
seedUse: The existing D46-a question restriction and rate-setting already make S01 superior authority the form of effort pricing.
